answer.reason: The verses tell of Beeroth being spared under Israel's oath and its people fleeing to Gittaim, beyond merely listing it among towns.

clauses.english: was spared by Israel because the princes had sworn to its people by the LORD
clauses.quote: the children of Israel smote them not

clauses.english: saw its people flee to Gittaim and live there as sojourners
clauses.quote: the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there

doubts: The murder of Ishbosheth by Rechab and Baanah and Nahari's service as Joab's armourbearer are deeds of men from Beeroth, not of the place, so they are left out.
Verses in JOS 18, EZR 2 and NEH 7 only list the town and were not used.
